saw_lines: Buyers of sleep systems compare firmness, materials and returns before they buy, and they rarely decide from one ad.
So the sale is won or lost in the first ad, when a buyer has no proof and no offer to trust.
Your 16 of 30 ads open on the same line, so repeat viewers stop reading. Test two new openers on your cold chamber and light treatment this week.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 16 of 30 ads open on “oft liegt das nicht an”, so repeat viewers stop reading. Test two new openers built on your cold chamber and light treatment, and keep the old line in one batch only.
One exact copy block runs in 16 of 30 ads, so the same body text appears again and again. Keep the body copy as is, but change the opening line and the image or video in each ad.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no count to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and lead with it in the first line of two ads.
Your 30 ads mention no offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Build one first order offer or a bundle and put it in line one of the cold chamber and light treatment ads.
